calls.statement:
SELECT 'sales' t, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_rl, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns of those', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT reason_code)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns all', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), 0 FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orphan returns', COUNT(*), 0,0,0 FROM fact_return_line r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, cs.format, cs.store_id, p.category
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
      AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
ret AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) refund_net, SUM(quantity_returned) qty_ret FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.format, COUNT(*) lines, SUM(s.net_amount) sold_net, SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net,0)) refund_net,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net,0))/SUM(s.net_amount),3) rr,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.net_amount<=0 OR s.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bad_sold,
       SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.qty_ret,0)>s.quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_ret
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.sales_line_id=s.sales_line_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT MIN(r.return_date) mn, MAX(r.return_date) mx, COUNT(*) n,
 SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date < f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
 SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_date > f.sale_date + 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over30,
 SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r999,
 SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rzz
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22'

SELECT 'format varies by store' k, COUNT(*) v FROM (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT format)>1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'excluded 999/ZZ lines in P2', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web lines w/o web order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND s.store_id=900 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order o WHERE o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web lines of cancelled orders', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' AND o.status='cancelled'
